title: Fried Green Tomatoes
tagline: Whistle Stop specials. Fried green and golden.
about: An unhappy housewife befriends an elderly woman who tells her the story of two friends who ran a café in 1930s Alabama.
cue: Serve the tomatoes when the story arrives at the Whistle Stop Café.
faces: WHISTLE STOP, ALABAMA • BY THE TRACKS
Down the line from our door. Every train stops, and so should you.
Green off the vine. Gold out of the pan.
Thick slices in buttermilk and cornmeal, fried in bacon drippings. Caper remoulade.
Ruth says I have to write something nice here. Coffee’s hot and Sipsey cooks. Short this week? Pay us next week.
No. 9 slows at the bend. Railroad Bill seen on the line again.
Prices subject to change. P.O. Box 91, Whistle Stop, Ala. Summer, 1932.
At the counter, or out on the porch where you can hear the trains come in.
Hot buttermilk biscuits, sweet butter, bee tree honey and a piece of the comb.
Idgie fetches it from the bee tree.
Two eggs any style, grits, a biscuit and sausage gravy.
Simmered with salt pork, a wedge of pan cornbread.
Pork shoulder roasted slow and pulled, tomato and cider vinegar sauce, slaw, white bread.
A mark on the gate tells a hungry man the cook won't turn him away.
Toasted pecans in brown sugar and cane syrup custard, flaky crust.
Brewed strong with ripe peaches, iced, lemon and mint.
I. Threadgoode and R. Jamison, props. Ask Sipsey about the sauce.

    StartersFried Green TomatoesThick slices in buttermilk and cornmeal, fried in bacon drippings. Caper remoulade.Served hot. Green off the vine, gold out of the pan.How to make it4 green tomatoes1 tsp salt200ml buttermilk150g fine cornmeal, seasoned150g bacon100g mayonnaise1 tbsp capers, chopped1/2 lemon, juicedSlice the tomatoes thick, salt them and leave for 10 minutes (included in cook time).Mix the mayonnaise with chopped capers and lemon juice for the remoulade.Cook the bacon in a large pan until crisp and the fat has run, and set the bacon aside.Dip the tomatoes in buttermilk then seasoned cornmeal and fry in the bacon fat until golden, turning once.Biscuits and HoneyHot buttermilk biscuits, sweet butter, bee tree honey and a piece of the comb.Idgie fetches it from the bee tree.How to make it140g cold butter300g plain flour3 tsp baking powder250ml buttermilk4 tbsp honey100g honeycombRub most of the butter into the flour and baking powder.Fold in the buttermilk, pat out and fold three times, then cut into rounds.Bake at 220°C until risen and golden.Serve warm with the remaining butter, honey and a chunk of honeycomb.MainsBig George's Barbecue PlatePork shoulder roasted slow and pulled, tomato and cider vinegar sauce, slaw, white bread.Ask Sipsey how it's done.How to make it1.5kg pork shoulder1 tbsp smoked paprika2 tbsp brown sugar2 garlic cloves, crushed150ml tomato sauce80ml cider vinegar1/4 cabbage, shredded3 tbsp mayonnaise1 loaf white breadRub the pork with the paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt.Roast covered at 150°C for 5 hours until falling apart (included in cook time).Simmer the tomato sauce with the vinegar until slightly thick, and pull the pork.Dress the pork with the sauce. Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for slaw and serve with white bread. The secret's in the sauce.SweetsPecan PieToasted pecans in brown sugar and cane syrup custard, flaky crust.By the slice, at the counter.How to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry3 eggs250ml golden syrup100g brown sugar60g butter, melted200g pecans, toastedLine a pie tin with the pastry and chill.Blind-bake with baking weights until pale gold, then remove the weights.Whisk the eggs, syrup, sugar and melted butter and stir in the pecans.Pour into the case and bake at 170°C until just set.Cool before slicing.DrinksPeach Sweet TeaBrewed strong with ripe peaches, iced, lemon and mint.Out on the porch, where you can hear the trains.How to make it6 black tea bags1 L just-boiled water3 peaches, 2 sliced and 1 for serving100g caster sugar1 lemon, sliced1 small bunch mint1 bag iceBrew the tea bags in the boiling water with two sliced peaches for 5 minutes.Remove the bags and stir in the sugar while hot.Cool completely with the peaches in, then chill (included in cook time) and strain.Pour over ice in tall glasses with lemon, fresh peach slices and mint.
